common_contract.pixel_style: measured native logical cells, nearest center sampling only, no antialiasing, no dithering, and no unsafe compression
common_contract.palette: dark forest green through saturated warm green with restrained yellow-green highlights; golden corn turret and dark bores

selection.selection_constraint: Preserve the compact low rosette silhouette and four-bore corn turret exactly; recolor foliage only, never convert it into a tall-stalk corn plant.

production_derivation.body_head_split: Warm golden material seeds retain one outline pixel; enclosed dark bores and the pale-green locator remain part of the turret.
production_derivation.body_idle_frames: Four frames share identical alpha and foot; frames 1-3 each change one internal highlight pixel.
production_derivation.turret_spin_frames: Four phases keep the outer shell and mount fixed while internal kernel colors, bore highlights, and locator phase rotate.
production_derivation.icon: Recompose body idle 0 and turret idle 0 using the declared body/head pivots.
production_derivation.shared_palette: One <=48-color palette from the selected composite is reused by every body, turret, flash, and icon output.
